name: Mu Shu-Style Pork with Broccoli Slaw & Mushrooms over Jasmine Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms; transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; thinly slice crosswise into bite-sized strips and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork strips and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes.

Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in another medium bowl along with soy sauce, cornstarch, peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, oil, vinegar, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
⅓ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp cornstarch
2 tbsp natural peanut butter
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground
3 pinch clove, ground
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the pork is done, use a slotted spoon to transfer the strips to a large plate and set aside.
Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add broccoli slaw and sauce to the pot; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender-crisp and sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes.
Return pork to the pot, along with any accumulated juices; stir to combine and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and pork stir-fry between plates. Enjoy!
